facts.fact: ESEPARC, a local policy research centre, co-convened with the Ministry of ICT a national consultative workshop on 13 May 2025 presenting preliminary research findings for regulations on the Royal Science and Technology Park.

SWZ.note: Park regulations are not clearly a named digital law or policy; no fact recorded.
The RSTP Act is a science park act; no startup law, labelling or fund is stated.

facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT says the Royal Science and Technology Park is enacted under the RSTP Act 2023, has had Government Computer Systems migrated to it, and awaits regulations for full operationalisation.
